brief: An interest media agency (Tenerife and Budapest) for established businesses: short-form video, paid ads, websites, automation and growth. The claim: social media is dead, interest has taken its place. The mark should be confident and modern, work as a profile picture and on reels, and grow out of the team's own shirt wordmark.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px and as a round profile picture, works white on video, one colour, on night blue and on cream; clearly not a copy of any agency's mark.

concepts.name: G2 · The phone that leans in
concepts.idea: A bold S on a 9:16 phone that leans in at 15 degrees; its foot is sliced off at the same 15 degrees as the A in SOCIAL.
rationale: Grows out of the team's own shirt wordmark: SOCIAL heavy, STREAM light, the A sliced once
One rule ties it together: every cut and lean is 15 degrees (the A, the phone's slice, its tilt, the S terminals)
The phone is the reel: it works as the profile picture, the favicon and the corner mark on video

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup by default, the stacked one for square formats and the shirt, and the phone alone wherever the name is already present (profile pictures, favicon, reels).
next_steps: Run a trademark search (HU/EU) before launch
Match the colours to Pantone at the first print job
Re-cut the brand film's title card with the new mark
